theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [x]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) :
      (intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs).eval (x k).val =
        A.eval y.val + (x k).val * B.eval y.val := by
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [eval_add, eval_comp, eval_mul, eval_X, hq, A, B]
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold, he]
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
        Nat.sub_add_eq, Fin.eta, eval_sum, eval_mul, eval_C, mul_sum,
        ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [x]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp [Fin2ToF2, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) :
      (intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs).eval (x k).val =
        A.eval y.val + (x k).val * B.eval y.val := by
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq, A, B]
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold]
      rw [he 0, he 1, sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
      rw! (castMode := .all) [Nat.sub_add_eq]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,
        ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc, Fin.eta]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val = (x 0).val + 1 := by
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ (by omega)]
    exact add_comm _ _
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) :
      (intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs).eval (x k).val =
        A.eval y.val + (x k).val * B.eval y.val := by
    rw [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs]
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq, A, B]
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold]
      rw [he 0, he 1, hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
      rw! (castMode := .all) [Nat.sub_add_eq]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,
        ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc, Fin.eta]

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by

    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y

        A.eval y.val + (x k).val * B.eval y.val := by

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only

    _ = _ := by

      rw! (castMode := .all) [Nat.sub_add_eq]

  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro y

    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y

    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)

        Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
        A, B]

      ring

      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
      rw! (castMode := .all) [Nat.sub_add_eq]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,

      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))

    ⟩)

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
        Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
        A, B]
      rw [hq 0, hq 1, sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
      rw! (castMode := .all) [Nat.sub_add_eq]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,
        ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc, Fin.eta]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val - (x 0).val = 1 := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, add_sub_cancel_right]
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
        Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
        A, B]
      rw [hq 0, hq 1, sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
      rw! (castMode := .all) [Nat.sub_add_eq]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,
        ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc, Fin.eta]

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs

    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
        Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
        A, B]
      rw [hq 0, hq 1, hd]
      ring

      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,
        ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc, Fin.eta]
      rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val
      ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans
        (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i i.isLt (x k)))).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
        Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
        A, B]
      rw [hq 0, hq 1, hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,
        ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc, Fin.eta]
      rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
        Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
        A, B]
      rw [hq 0, hq 1, hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [← Polynomial.eval_C_mul, ← Polynomial.eval_C_mul, ← Polynomial.eval_add]
      congr 1
      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta,
        Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, mul_sum, ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
      rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  let A := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let B := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  calc
    _ = (1 - r_chal) * A.eval y.val + r_chal * B.eval y.val := by
      simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
        Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
        A, B, hq]
      rw [hd]
      ring
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [A, B, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
      simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,
        ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc, Fin.eta]
      rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  rw [hd]
  simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly, Fin.eta]
  rw! (castMode := .all) [Nat.sub_add_eq]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
    add_mul, mul_assoc, sum_add_distrib, ←mul_sum, Fin.eta]
  ring

  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :

  ⟩) coeffs

      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)

  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>

      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  dsimp only [x] at hq hd
  simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
  rw [hd]
  conv_lhs => ring_nf (config := {recursive := false})
  simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,

    mul_sum, sum_mul, ←sum_sub_distrib, ←sum_add_distrib, mul_assoc, mul_comm r_chal]
  rfl

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  let x := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) y
  have hq (k : Fin 2) : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (x k).val = y.val := by
    have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
      (x k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    rw [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate] at h
    exact (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm
  dsimp only [x] at hq
  have hd : (x 1).val = 1 + (x 0).val := by
    simp only [x, qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val +
    r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
    rw [hd]
    ring
  · simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, mul_sum,
      ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl

  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)

  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by

    r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,

    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  dsimp only
  intro y
  have hq := fun k : Fin 2 =>
    (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate,
    Subtype.eq_iff] at hq
  trans (1 - r_chal) * (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val +
    r_chal * (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  · simp only [fold, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs,
      Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, hq]
    simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Fin2ToF2, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul, one_smul,
      zero_add, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
    ring
  · simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      Polynomial.eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_C_mul, mul_sum,
      ←sum_add_distrib, add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl
